title: Astraloria Music for Maestro
description: This is a music resource pack that requires Obscuria's Maestro mod to function.
body:
The resource pack is too large for modrinth, you may download the current beta for 1.20.1 below:

https://github.com/solvicta/Astraloria-Music/releases/download/1.20.1/AstraloriaMusic-ForMaestro-1.0-beta.zip


Requires Maestro:

https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/maestro
https://modrinth.com/mod/maestro-music
----
This is a music resource pack that requires Obscuria's Maestro mod to function. Designed to go with my upcoming modpack, Astraloria, this music pack features mostly ambient and melodic tracks that would fit into an adventure-oriented pack. 

----
I highly recommend installing CreativeMD's AmbientSounds alongside this; there will eventually be some pauses added between some of the music tracks to allow you to enjoy the sound of the environment as you explore.

https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ambientsounds

https://modrinth.com/mod/ambientsounds


I have a custom ambience pack coming up for that mod as well, not quite finished though :3

----
I also recommend disabling vanilla music while using this pack, as most of the tracks do not quite fit the same theme. 

To do so, locate the Maestro config file (config/obscuria/maestro-client.toml) and make sure the config reads vanilla_enabled = false


----
Current Features:

Biome tag specific music

Day/night specific music

Underwater music

Weather music

Title Screen music

Generic fallback music if there are no matching tags





Future:

Other Dimensions

Short jingles for special events

Boss-specific music

Entity-specific music

Structure-specific music

Sailing & riding music

Breaks between songs

Track normalization
